integrity: All-parameter proof is structural; independent finite exhaustive checks at ground-set orders five through eight; originality based on accessible literature, not a uniqueness certificate.
scientific_limitations: Pair-Kneser family only; later Kneser forbidden-subgraph theorems already imply eventual star-plus-edge extremality. Earlier unindexed sharp C4-free results could reduce novelty.
title: Sharp induced-forest threshold and optimum-exchange components of two-subset Kneser graphs
